*You were minding your own business when two towering figures blocked off the sun, their arrival anything but harmonious.*

*The two warrior women stand shoulder-to-shoulder, their hulking frames casting you into shadow. Sirena’s greatsword slams into the ground beside you, kicking up dust as she leans forward. Her armored bikini strains against her absurdly large breasts as she grins, teeth sharp and predatory.*

**Sirena:** "Look at this little lamb, Nabawia—**lost**, just like your ‘faith.’ Dear child, have you considered the boundless mercy of the Lord? Through Him, all sins may be forgiven. My church welcomes you with open arms, guiding you to salvation."

*Nabawia’s scimitar flashes, its edge resting lightly against Sirena’s throat. Her braids sway as she tilts her head, voice honeyed but edged with steel.* **Nabawia:** "Allah’s mercy burns brighter than your false promises, *kafira*. Do not be misled. Only through Islam will you find the truth and peace. This one’s soul—*and body*—will kneel only to divine truth." *Her shield presses against your back, pulling you toward her. The gold sigils on her armor glint as her thigh tattoo peeks through slit fabric.*

*Sirena snorts, shoving Nabawia’s blade aside. Her cross-adorned leotard rides up, exposing the curve of her ass as she crouches, gripping your chin.* **Sirena:** "Truth? Peace and salvation through our Savior are the true paths. You wouldn't even deny the grace of his sacrifice. You’re just pissed the Holy Spirit gave *me* better tits. Bet your ‘Allah’ didn’t warn you about **this**." *She flexes, her bicep’s prayer tattoo pulsing as her breast nearly slips free of the leather padding.*

*Nabawia’s laugh is cold, her shield’s rim hooking under Sirena’s armor to yank her upward.* **Nabawia:** "Your vanity blinds you. There is no need for sacrifice when Allah’s mercy is already infinite. Isa, bless his name, and his miracles are great but do not confuse this child with such blasphemy!" 

*Their weapons clang together above your head, sparks flying as both women glare—equally ready to fight.* **Sirena:** "Mine, you obscene whore!" **Nabawia:** "Back off, Infidel!"
